global_estimate.method: Each disclosed level is projected to November 3 on that company’s own dated trend; components without a trend are held or estimated with stated ranges. Router traffic (OpenRouter) is excluded to avoid double counting hosts and labs. Logical tokens include cached input. Low = latest levels held flat or the low estimate; high = trend ×1.25 or the high estimate. This is an estimate, not a disclosure.

components.name: Anthropic

components.growth_basis: Consumption revenue/day H1 → Q3 at a constant realized price
components.note: Q3 revenue ÷ $0.80 per million logical tokens, the OpenRouter-measured Claude mix (80% cache reads, 2% output) at list prices. Range $0.6–1.3/Mtok. Cloud marketplaces: Anthropic recognizes CSP-marketplace sales gross; 44% of January–September revenue ($33.2B) is ≈$14.6B, or ≈67T/day through Bedrock, Vertex AI and Foundry combined at ≈$0.80/Mtok (January–September average), ≈56% of consumption-billed traffic if those sales are all consumption. This is inside the Anthropic estimate, not additional; no cloud reports Anthropic-only tokens, and Bedrock’s 17× growth has no absolute baseline.

OpenAI has not said whether its tokens/min counts cached input; Anthropic’s estimate includes ~80% cache reads, so the like-for-like gap may be smaller.
